connect(+Path, +Alias)
--8<-- [end:connect_sig]

disconnect(+Alias)
--8<-- [end:disconnect_sig]

--8<-- [start:current_connection_sig]
current_connection(?Alias)
--8<-- [end:current_connection_sig]

--8<-- [start:query_sig]

--8<-- [start:query_params_sig]

--8<-- [start:exec_params_sig]

--8<-- [start:crud_example]
-import_from(sqlite, [connect, exec, query])

Init <- (
    connect(":memory:", "app"),
    exec("app", "CREATE TABLE notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, body TEXT)")
)

add_note(BODY) <- exec("app", "INSERT INTO notes (body) VALUES (?)", [BODY])

all_notes(ID, BODY) <- query("app", "SELECT id, body FROM notes", (ID, BODY))

search_notes(TERM, BODY) <- (
    query("app", "SELECT body FROM notes WHERE body LIKE ?", [TERM], BODY)
)
--8<-- [end:crud_example]

--8<-- [start:join_example]
-import_from(sqlite, [connect, exec, query])

Setup <- (
    connect(":memory:", "hr"),
    exec("hr", "CREATE TABLE dept (id INTEGER, name TEXT)"),
    exec("hr", "CREATE TABLE emp (name TEXT, dept_id INTEGER)"),
    exec("hr", "INSERT INTO dept VALUES (1, 'Engineering')"),
    exec("hr", "INSERT INTO dept VALUES (2, 'Marketing')"),
    exec("hr", "INSERT INTO emp VALUES ('Alice', 1)"),
    exec("hr", "INSERT INTO emp VALUES ('Bob', 2)")
)

emp_dept(EMP, DEPT) <- (
    Setup,
    query("hr",
        "SELECT emp.name, dept.name FROM emp JOIN dept ON emp.dept_id = dept.id",
        (EMP, DEPT))
)
--8<-- [end:join_example]

--8<-- [start:schema_example]
-import_from(sqlite, [connect, table, column])

describe(DB) <- (
    table(DB, TABLE),
    ++print(f"\n{TABLE}:"),
    column(DB, TABLE, COL, TYPE),
    ++print(f"  {COL} {TYPE}")
)
--8<-- [end:schema_example]
